CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERRELATEDPARTY_SYN
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty AS (
	SELECT 
     CASE WHEN ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM_%' THEN BCA.ORGKEY 
          WHEN ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBS_CRM_%' THEN BCA.ORGKEY 
          WHEN ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_Cards_%' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,REPLACE(SGC.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,'CBC_Cards_',''))
          WHEN ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBSec%' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, LEN(RIGHT(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,CHARINDEX('_', REVERSE(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR))+7)), 4) )
          ELSE NULL END AS CustomerId
    ,GLOBAL_CIF AS PartyId
    ,'Global CIF' AS CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
    ,insert_dttm AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,Entity AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE SGC 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTID,ORGKEY FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE ISLATEST = 1) BCA ON BCA.ACCOUNTID = CASE WHEN ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM_%' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,REPLACE(SGC.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,'CBC_CRM_','')) 
                                                                                                              WHEN ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBS_CRM_%' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,REPLACE(SGC.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR,'CBS_CRM_','')) END

	)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
         CustomerId
        ,PartyId
        ,CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
        ,FinancialInstitutionId
        )) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerId
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty

)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
         CustomerId
        ,PartyId
        ,CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
        ,FinancialInstitutionId
        )) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;



INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty (
 CustomerId
,PartyId
,CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerRelatedPartyNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,PartyId AS PartyId
,CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId AS CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerRelatedPartyNote
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty (
 CustomerId
,PartyId
,CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerRelatedPartyNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,PartyId AS PartyId
,CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId AS CustomerPartyRelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerRelatedPartyNote
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedParty;


END
